verdict.rationale: Ashby shows pieces of background automation, though none is clearly a user-configured autonomous automation. Webhooks enable automated responses to events like candidate status changes, but the automation logic runs outside Ashby. The Slack integration auto-creates interview channels, and the AI Notetaker runs across all interviews without extra steps. Custom agents exist 'for repeated workflows', but the evidence shows them invoked on demand through chat or Slack, not running on their own. Missing for 10: native scheduled or event-triggered agent automations configurable in-product, documentation of agents running unattended in the background, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
